telegrams.body: THE CREW LIST SENT YESTERDAY DOES NOT INCLUDE THE NEW RADIO OFFICER WHO JOINED AT THE LAST PORT ALL OTHER ARRIVAL DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN CHECKED AND ARE READY FOR INSPECTION AT YOKOHAMA IT IS IMPORTANT THAT THE REQUIRED COPIES BE STAMPED AND RETURNED BEFORE SAILING
